0b99934b.name: Tail Risk Identification — Historical Analogue Scan
0b99934b.description: Use historical extreme event analogues to identify current tail risk signals missed by standard models.

hypothesis.statement: Analogue scanning identifies ≥80% of known tail risk events 14+ days before onset

8af80ef5.name: Anti-Fragility Stress Test — Portfolio Resilience Under Cascade Failure
8af80ef5.description: Simulate correlated cascade failure across asset classes and measure portfolio drawdown and recovery time.

hypothesis.statement: Anti-fragile portfolio design reduces max drawdown by ≥30% vs standard diversification during cascade

280bc3ab.name: Preparedness Checklist — Black Swan Readiness Score
280bc3ab.description: Evaluate operational readiness across 8 black swan scenario categories using a structured preparedness rubric.
